clues: This town lies in south central Colombia, in a land famed for coffee. Old settler ways still shape its farms and daily life here.
This one town has many kinds of weather in one small place. Low land by the Cauca River feels unlike the town seat high on the mountain.
In twenty eleven, UNESCO put its old center and farm lands on its world list. The honor praised its coffee lands and old town ways.
Its airport name is Aeropuerto del Café, and it shouts its coffee roots. Farm exports fly from here to far markets.
Think of a place whose heart and fields are guarded as a treasure for all mankind. Guides rank its streets among the globe’s most prized cultural landscapes.
